input.doNotSupply: Any target, requested action, earlier reference, expected answer, historical outcome or evaluator result

expected.behavior: Clarify both missing action and missing target; do not invent confident implementation, deployment or security audit recommendation; uncertain must not become accepted no-skill []

steps.action: Receive parent-verified candidate commit/tree, independent SOURCE verdict, remote fixed candidate proof, common exact Claude model/effort and successful API-only authentication procedure, preflight results and approved usage accounting. No calls until all received.

Create separate immutable verified candidate checkout and run artifacts; verify commit/tree, clean source, manifest/generated plugin digests and applicable AGENTS.md/SKILL.md. Never substitute main or c6a8019. Record plugin version and actual loaded plugin/MCP surface.

Prepare fresh Claude session/workspace without prior conversation or inferred target; expose only approved candidate plugin and scoped writable evidence paths, per parent approved procedure. Preserve persistent auth, network and permissions. Read exact original prompt bytes; do not provide oracle or historical answer to Claude.

Process original prompt as the actual host; decide whether action and target are known, perform applicable candidate host workflow/MCP operations and issue real clarification. Sol must not select skills, replace Claude actions, synthesize host receipt or answer on Claude behalf.

Capture real Claude process/session/tool observations and output in private run artifacts; bind prompt/candidate/config/model digests. Record actual selectionStatus and ID null/[] distinction, missing-input reasons, actual stage evidence and side effects. For clarification-only null use authentic transcript evidence; do not fabricate accepted-selection receipt or mark irrelevant applied stages complete.

Record total cost, input/output/cache tokens, failures and retries from actual provider/CLI records. No JEV; stop additional calls near US$2 or on unresolved cost. Score frozen original oracle without modifying criteria; distinguish PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_RUN and sanitized published evidence.
